summary: Keep duplicate-envelope canonical position joins and replica repair idempotent when escalation clock maintenance is already pending.

replay.detail: Canonical minimum-position joins and repaired-record invalidation retain their existing semantics; no replay is required.

schema.detail: Opening a store replaces the five member-local escalation pending triggers with explicit conflict-safe UPSERTs. Existing clock and pending rows are retained.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: No protocol, receipt, or public API changes.

downtime.detail: Trigger replacement occurs in the normal store-open transaction.

recovery.detail: No authoritative data is changed; escalation clocks remain rebuildable.
